serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The CloudLCMS is a rapid authoring learning content management platform. The CloudLCMS produces fully 508 compliant eLearning courses that are able to be exported in SCORM 1.2, 2004, xAPI and HTML. The courses are fully responsive and utilize a deep scrolling design that will function on all modern PC and mobile platforms. The system is a collaborative environment that allows developers to work together with a team or individually. The CloudLCMS allows for custom themes and menus along with plugins to extend functionality within training courses.
